defs.def: a film/movie, book or play that is based on a particular piece of work but that has been changed for a new situation 改编本；改写本

ex.s: Here I will stress some smarter and more creative examples of climate adaptation.
ex.t: 在这里我将强调一些更智能、更有创意的气候适应案例。

ex.s: This is why, in part at least, the US National Climate Assessment says that: ＂There is no ‘one-size fits all’ adaptation.＂ Nevertheless, there are some actions that offer much and carry little risk or cost.
ex.t: 这就是为什么美国国家气候评估在某种程度上说："没有'一刀切'的适应方案。"尽管如此，有些行动收益很大而风险或成本很低。

ex.s: More ordinary forms of adaptation are happening everywhere.
ex.t: 更为普通的适应形式正在各地发生。

ex.s: But the most sensible form of adaptation is surely to adapt our energy systems to emit less carbon pollution.
ex.t: 但最明智的适应方式无疑是调整我们的能源系统以减少碳排放。

ex.s: global warming affects adaptation formsD. adaptation to climate change is challenging
ex.t: 全球变暖影响适应形式D. 适应气候变化具有挑战性

ex.s: Give your opinion of the movie adaptation.
ex.t: 请给出您对电影改编的看法。

ex.s: Background information The Revenge of Zidan is an adaptation of Hamlet into Peking Opera by Shanghai Jingju Theatre Company.
ex.t: 背景资料《紫丹的复仇》是上海京剧团将《哈姆雷特》改编成京剧。

ex.t: （改编自路德维希·范·贝多芬（ Ludwig van Beethoven ）的《海利根斯塔特遗嘱》（ fHeiligenstadt Testament ） ）有史以来的首选，都挤满了来适应各种微小的驱动力......

ex.s: The intention of these adaptations is to make the classics more accessible to young readers.
ex.t: 这些改编的目的是让年轻读者更容易阅读经典。

ex.t: （改编自艾萨克·阿西莫夫（ Isaac Asimov ）的《男孩最好的朋友》）标题作者设置•时间： •地点：人物吉米，一个月亮出生的男孩情节吉米的父母从地球上得到一只狗。

defs.def: the process of changing sth, for example your behaviour, to suit a new situation 适应

ex.s: On Thursday in an article published in Cell, a team of researchers reported a new kind of adaptation - not to air or to food, but to the ocean.
ex.t: 周四在《细胞》杂志发表的一篇文章中，一组研究人员报告了一种新的适应——不是针对空气或食物，而是针对海洋。

ex.s: When it comes to adaptation, it is important to understand that climate change is a process.
ex.t: 说到适应，重要的是要理解气候变化是一个过程。

ex.s: adaptation is an ever-changing processB. the cost of adaptation varies with time
ex.t: 适应是一个不断变化的过程B. 适应的成本随时间变化
